column1: # UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20 units of measure - the curated subset PeakFlow invoices in.
# See database/iso/provenance.json. Rec 20 has over 1,500 codes; this is the subset that
# appears on invoices for services, software, utilities, logistics and ordinary goods.
# dimension exists so a comparison or conversion between incompatible units can be refused
# rather than producing a number. It is PeakFlow's classification, not part of Rec 20.
